nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Firming Night Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results: one with relatively oily skin says it does not irritate her skin, worsen her acne, or enlarge her pores, while another with oily-side skin reports it clogged her pores and left her feeling greasy in the morning.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin report the cream deeply hydrates, ends flaking and dry patches, and leaves their skin soft through winter, though a few say it barely moisturized them or left their skin as dry or drier than before, and one reports it caused breakouts and stinging.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report balanced results, including fewer breakouts along the jawline and less shine around the nose, though one reviewer says it makes her oily nose slicker and shinier.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or eczema, report no irritation and say it calms redness and dryness without causing breakouts, though one reviewer with sensitive skin says it still caused red bumps and did not perform as claimed.
segments.mature: One 66-year-old reviewer with oily and dry patches and facial eczema reports the cream has greatly diminished her eczema with regular use and never leaves her skin feeling greasy.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report firmer, smoother, plumper-looking skin and fewer fine lines with regular use; however multiple reviewers say they have not noticed a definitive firming effect even after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the cream as deeply hydrating, ending flaking and dry patches and leaving skin soft overnight, including for very dry or winter-stressed skin; a few reviewers say it barely moisturized them or left their dry skin just as dry or drier than before.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation, and several say it calms existing redness, itchiness or rosacea-related flare-ups, including around the mouth and on the cheeks; however two reviewers with dry or sensitive skin report it made their face red, caused stinging, or left red bumps.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers say the cream helps keep the skin barrier intact through winter and soothes a damaged barrier when paired with retinol use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer prone to dark spots reports they significantly faded after resuming regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone or cystic-acne-prone, report no new breakouts and say it does not clog their pores; however two reviewers say it triggered acne or clogged their pores and made them break out.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including some with oily or combination skin, say the cream absorbs without a greasy finish and does not leave their skin looking oily; a couple of reviewers with oily areas say it feels greasy if they use too much or makes their oily nose slicker and shinier.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick, buttery texture that absorbs well
Layers well under makeup and serums
Comes in a reusable glass jar
Considered pricey for the jar size
A little goes a long way
Needs layering with other products for some

extraits.texte: This winter, my forehead is the driest it has ever been and I was on the hunt for a very moisturizing night cream. I saw this and thought it would be perfect since Ive heard great reviews on the basic ultra repair cream, and this night cream even has a scale with a cactus on it meaning it is good for very dry skin. Ive been using it for over a month now and honestly, my forehead has only gotten drier. It is super flaky and rough, and I put on a decent amount of this night cream, but I still wake up every morning with dry skin. Im going to finish the container since it is expensive and it does come with a lot of product, but it definitely is not for dry skin like it advertises.

It clogged my pores and made me feel greasy in the a.m. used it for a few weeks thinking it was something out and I lost the clear skin I worked so hard for trying something new. I have skin more on the oily side. I wanted to like it but it isn't for me.

Not impressed I was recommended this product. Bought the whole line for face and eyes. I have sensitive skin and I still had issues with nightcream. Skin became it with red bumps. Did not do as claimed.

I've been using this moisturizer nightly for about a month and I'm definitely noticing a difference in the look and feel of my face. My skin is combination and I had been dealing with breaking out along my jawline. My skin is transforming! The breakouts are lessening and my skin texture is improving. My husband even commented that he noticed a difference and asked me what I was doing differently! I think with continued use this product will become a mainstay in my routine. I like to apply it to my neck and chest too. A little goes a long way and it absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling so hydrated and soft. This product is packed with really high quality ingredients and is affordable.
I have super sensitive dry skin and o suffer from eczema. This transformed my skin and made it glass! No more pumps or dry patches.

I have been using this cream for over a year and just used up my first tub of this amazing moisturizer. I am 66 years old, I have oily in some places, and dry in others and I have eczema on my face, although my eczema is still there, it has diminished greatly and regular use of this cream helps. I use it every night and sometimes twice a day in the winter. If you have dry, troubled skin, give this a try, it is creamy, goes on like a dream and if used during the day, my make still glides on if I use it, never greasy or feeling heavy. My skin just drinks it up. Give it a try, you will love it.

i'm so happy i discovered FAB about a year and a half ago. i love all of their ultra repair products but this one is by far my favorite. a few months ago i ran out of it and switched to a cheaper moisturizer to save money. i am prone to breakouts and have cystic acne. i get a lot of dark spots and have combination to oily skin. i finally was so sick of the dark spots and the blemishes not clearing so i went back to FAB. literally after one use, i woke up with the dark spots significantly faded. my skin is so sensitive and i love the gentle smell. it feels like butter on my face but has never caused breakouts. my partner even said my face looked and felt so smooth and supple. i'm so thankful for FAB.
